title: Dynamics of Collective Diversity in Human-AI Co-Creation for Creative Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.33192v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI systems are increasingly deployed at scale to support human users in creative tasks across a variety of domains. However, as more users adopt the same AI agent, the resulting artifacts may become increasingly homogeneous, leading to a collapse in collective diversity. Prior work has documented this risk, but lacks a systematic framework for understanding how collective diversity changes as AI adoption scales across co-creation settings. In this work, we conduct a large-scale crowdsourcing study to understand and model the dynamics of collective diversity, quality, and effort in human-AI co-creation across two creative domains: Creative Hypothesis Generation and Creative Story Writing. We find that current AI agents used in co-creation can improve artifact quality and reduce effort, but at the cost of declining collective diversity as adoption increases. translated_title: 创意任务中人机共创的集体多样性动态
translated_abstract: 生成式AI系统正越来越多地被大规模部署，以支持人类用户在各领域的创意任务。然而，随着越来越多的用户采用相同的AI代理，由此产生的作品可能变得日益同质化，导致集体多样性的崩塌。先前的研究已经记录了这一风险，但缺乏一个系统性框架来理解随着AI采用规模的扩大，集体多样性在共创环境中如何变化。在本工作中，我们开展了一项大规模众包研究，以理解和建模人机共创在两个创意领域（创意假设生成和创意故事写作）中集体多样性、质量和努力程度的动态变化。我们发现，当前用于共创的AI代理能够提升作品质量并减少用户的努力，但代价是随着采用规模的增加，集体多样性会下降。我们进一步表明，更细粒度的人机交互以及……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过大规模众包研究揭示了人机共创的动态规律：AI代理虽能提升创意作品质量并降低用户投入，但随着AI采用规模扩大，会导致集体多样性不断下降。
en_tdlr: Through a large-scale crowdsourcing study, this paper reveals that AI agents in human-AI co-creation improve artifact quality and reduce user effort, but collective diversity declines as AI adoption scales up.
